elaine: Heads-up — CI evals started failing on the new chat-template tests after the metric-hook change. Not seeing failures locally. Error in runner: 'escape_sequence_unhandled' in tokenizer stage. Logs below.

mohit: Can you paste the failing CI job link and PR?

elaine: https://github.com/redwood/inference/actions/runs/123456789 — PR #842 (refactor/metric-hooks) is the one. failing log excerpt:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/runner/eval_runner.py", line 412, in run_case
    toks = tokenizer.encode(chat_template)
  File "/lib/tokenizers/custom.py", line 98, in encode
    raise TokenizerError("escape_sequence_unhandled")
TokenizerError: escape_sequence_unhandled: found "\\u001b" in template
```

jun: hmm we added a metric hook that injects color-coded diffs into chat templates for better debugging; maybe ANSI escape codes leaked into the template fixtures. @ci-bot can you print the template before tokenization in CI?

ci-bot: Added print step to job 123456789; output posted as artifact (artifact_id=art-974). Link: https://ci/redwood/artifacts/art-974

elaine: artifact shows templates include ANSI color spans like '\\u001b[31m' before the tokenizer runs. Local runs don't reproduce because our local fixture generator strips debug coloring. PR #842 probably forgot to sanitize debug output.

mohit: interesting — metric hook wants human diffs but runner should sanitize templates before tokenization. Quick fix: run regex sanitize: `re.sub(r'\\x1b\\\\\\[[0-9;]*m', '', s)` inside tokenize path. I can open a tiny PR to add sanitize step in eval_runner.tokenize().

jun: prefer adding a sanitizer util in eval/utils and call from runner + add unit test that inserts ANSI codes into fixtures. Also add a CI regression to fail if metric hook outputs are attached to canonical templates.

elaine: agree. Also we should update the dashboard metric exporter to strip color codes for string metrics; I can take that.

mohit: created PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/849 — adds sanitizer and unit test. pinging @jun for review.

jun: reviewing now. small nits but LGTM other than one flaky assertion: the unit test depended on locale settings, I made it deterministic.

devex: FYI this change may interact with chat template escaping for function-call sentinels. Please confirm function sentinel tokens are preserved after sanitize (we should not strip algo-specific control sequences). Recommend adding e2e in sandbox.

elaine: good catch. I ran the sandbox e2e and function sentinels still parse correctly. Pushed sandbox logs to the PR as an artifact.

mohit: CI re-run on #849 is green. Planning to deploy to canary tonight.

elaine: closing this incident in thread but adding follow-ups on the board: 1) add sanitizer to metric exporter (elaine), 2) CI regression for colored diffs (jun), 3) docs note about debug hooks and sanitizer (devex).

elaine: filing follow-ups in project board. Thanks all :thumbsup:
